# The browser

A headless Chrome of your own, on an empty profile: nobody's logins are in it. Drive it with the `browser` command, always run by its full name: `npx @openagt/skill-browser@0.1`. It needs Chrome on the machine, or `CHROME_PATH` set to a Chrome or Chromium executable.

```
npx @openagt/skill-browser@0.1 open <address>       open the address, starting the browser if none is open
npx @openagt/skill-browser@0.1 read                 print the page again

=== README.md (      51 lines)
# Hello

A single static page. No build step, no dependencies. It renders one centered
greeting — "Hello, and welcome." — on a dark background, and nothing else. The
favicon is a white "H" on a rounded square in the same dark colour as the page.

## Files

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.html` | The whole page — markup and inline styles |
| `favicon.svg` | Favicon for modern browsers |
| `favicon.ico` | Fallback favicon for browsers that ignore the SVG |

## Run it locally

Open the file directly:

```sh
open index.html
```

Or serve it over HTTP, which matches production more closely:

```sh
python3 -m http.server 8000
# then visit http://localhost:8000
```
